name: noneos-core
description: As the core engine of the next generation of NoneOS
author: Yao

scripts.dev: npm run static & npm run watch:sw
scripts.bump: node scripts/bump.js && npm i && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:hashes && npm run build:sw && npm run build:skill
scripts.build:hashes: node scripts/calculate-nos-hashes.js && node scripts/sign-hashes.js && rm -f hashes.json && node scripts/pack-nos.js && node scripts/verify-pack.js && node scripts/calculate-noslib-hashes.js && node scripts/sign-noslib-hashes.js && node scripts/verify-noslib-manifest.js && rm -f noslib-hashes.json
